All 31 tasks are complete and marked `[X]`. No `after_implement` hooks are registered. Implementation is finished and verified.

## ✅ Implementation complete — Bookmark Manager v1

**Tests: 24/24 unit passing · 11/11 end-to-end passing.** The app was smoke-tested against the production `npm start` command and binds `0.0.0.0:4000`.

### What was built

A single Node.js + Express app serving a JSON API and a vanilla-JS frontend, with SQLite persistence — exactly the approved plan.

| Layer | Files |
|---|---|
| **Server** | `server/index.js`, `server/app.js`, `server/db.js`, `server/bookmarks.repo.js`, `server/routes/{bookmarks,tags}.js` |
| **Shared libs** | `server/lib/url.js` (validate/normalize), `server/lib/title.js` (best-effort title fetch) |
| **Frontend** | `public/index.html`, `public/app.js`, `public/styles.css` |
| **Tests** | `tests/unit/*.test.js` (3 files), `tests/e2e/*.spec.js` (4 files) |
| **Config** | `package.json`, `playwright.config.js`, `.gitignore`, `README.md`, `.harness/app.json` |

### All four user stories delivered
- **US1 Save** — validate URL (http/https only), best-effort page-title fetch with fallback, duplicate rejection, persisted with timestamps.
- **US2 Browse/open** — newest-first list, titles open in a new tab, distinct empty state.
- **US3 Edit/delete** — inline edit, delete-with-confirmation, changes persist.
- **US4 Tags/search** — tag filter chips, keyword search across title/address/tags, distinct no-results state.

### Two implementation notes (fidelity to spec/plan, no behavior change)
1. **Test script uses a glob** (`node --test "tests/unit/**/*.test.js"`) rather than the literal `node --test tests/unit` in the task text — Node 24's runner treats a bare directory as a file. Same intent, working command.
2. **Added a test-only reset endpoint** (`POST /api/test/reset`) gated behind `ENABLE_TEST_RESET=1`, set only by the Playwright runner — never enabled in the delivered app. This gives the E2E suite clean isolation.

Neither touches the spec's behavior; both are within the plan's testing approach, so no spec/plan revision is warranted.

### Ready for review
Port 4000 was left free, so the harness will start a **fresh, empty** instance (the empty state is a valid ready state and is marked `data-harness-ready="true"`). The client reaches it at **`http://maker:4000`**.

**Try:** add a URL (e.g. `https://example.com`) → see it listed → tag it, search/filter it → edit or delete it.

If anything looks off during your review, tell me and I'll route it correctly — a divergence from the approved spec I'll fix by continuing implementation; a genuine spec change I'll take back through `speckit-specify` and re-plan before rebuilding, per our SDD workflow.
